note: Guild Campaign wire scenario. The driven player is provisioned at level 41 and the fixture step seeds forty days of personal activity (the guild is created through the stock createTeam call). 601/611/603/614/605/606/607/608/615 run through the stock SelfGuild model calls the windows use; 604 and 610 are raw requests because SelectTeamNewWindow's guild branch needs an open map window beyond the provisioned normal chapter, and the stock battle scene needs a full client-reported result. The 610 body asserts the two numeric rank_award fields whose absence crashes BattleCreate.lua:3099. Guild Campaign refuses entry 21:00-24:00 UTC (rule 7), so this scenario must run outside that window.
